_comment: Toolchain pin for the layout/ verification flow (klt drc / klt extract /
klt lvs), checked -- not merely recorded -- before any layout/ runner
does anything. This is a CAPABILITY list, not a version number: `klt
--version` reports klayout-tools' own static pyproject.toml version,
which can lag well behind what commands an install actually has.
`klt_required_commands` is the drift-detectable pin instead --
every layout/ runner should look each entry up in `klt --help`'s
subcommand list before doing anything else and fail loudly, naming
the missing command and the install command to fix it, rather than
skip the check silently. Keep ONE shared implementation (conventionally
`layout/toolchain_pin.py`) that every DRC/LVS/extraction runner
imports, rather than re-deriving this check per runner -- otherwise
the runners can drift apart on what they check.
THIS FILE IS A BOOTSTRAP STARTER: sg13g2-sat-rx has not chosen a klt pin
yet, so klt_install / klt_last_verified_commit below are placeholders,
not a foreign repo's history. Fill them in with the exact commit you
verify `klt drc` (and `extract` / `lvs`, once those runners exist)
against when this repo's layout/ harness first comes up (the standard
opening issue #2), and re-check klayout_package_min against
klayout-tools' current pyproject.toml floor at the same time. From
that point on, keep this comment APPEND-ONLY: record each later pin
bump as a new paragraph naming the issue, what changed upstream, and
why, rather than editing or deleting an earlier one. A correction to
an earlier paragraph gets its own new paragraph too -- never an edit
to the one it corrects -- so a later reader can see why the pin is
where it is without re-deriving it from git blame.
Field reference:
klt_install            exact commit to install `klt` from -- a
`pip`/`uv tool install` VCS URL pinned with
`@<sha>` (no PyPI release yet), never a
floating branch reference.
klt_required_commands  every `klt <command>` this repo's layout/
runners invoke. A missing one should be a
tooling error (exit 1) from any runner that
needs it, not a silently-skipped check.
Starts with just `drc` -- the first thing a
fresh layout/ harness wires up -- and grows
as `extract`/`lvs` runners are added.
klt_last_verified_commit  the exact commit klt_install resolves to,
restated here so it is visible without
parsing the install URL. Update both
together and re-run every runner's --check
when bumping.
klayout_package_min    floor for the pip `klayout` package version
(klayout-tools' own pyproject.toml pins a
floor of its own; recorded here so a drift
in *this* repo's pin is visible next to
klt's).
PIN BUMP 2026-10-12 (issue #185, layout-chain readiness probe):
First time this repo's layout/ chain was actually exercised. Verified
`klt drc` / `extract` / `lvs` / `ring-check` / `economy` against the
installed build 0.7.0+gb770c86e0e96 -- a post-v0.7.0-tag build of
2AMLogic/klayout-tools@b770c86e0e963600d27c6403d838c06d9b25cd88 (its
parent a3597b9d77ca is the v0.7.0 lock-file-maintenance merge the
0.7.0 wheel corresponds to) -- against PDK ihp-sg13g2 v0.3.0
(@5cccb161f7492697cfa52eb14dc03beb00bdca9e, the sim/pdk-artifact.json
pin). klayout_package_min re-checked the same day against klt's own
pyproject.toml floor: still 0.30 (installed bundle ships klayout
0.30.12). klt_required_commands grew from [drc] to the five commands
the probe invokes; layout/probe-readiness/generate_probe.py is, for
now, the one runner that checks this list before doing anything.
Per-command outcomes: layout/probe-readiness/README.md.
PIN BUMP 2026-10-27 (issue #234, klt 0.7.0 -> 0.8.0 release pin):
klayout-tools now has PyPI releases, so klt_install moves from the
b770c86e0e96 VCS URL to the release pin `klayout-tools==0.8.0`, and
klt_last_verified_commit is the full sha of tag v0.8.0
(c572046be644e0407f693f2410f3abb799d68a3a). The two field-reference
lines above that describe klt_install as a VCS URL `(no PyPI release
yet)` are superseded by this paragraph: klt_install is now a PyPI
requirement string, and klt_last_verified_commit is the commit that
release tag resolves to. This is the same pin signoff.yml installs.
The 2026-10-12 probe records (layout/probe-readiness/runs/) were taken
at the earlier build and are NOT re-run or rewritten by this bump;
re-running the probe at 0.8.0 would be a separate, later record.
RE-RUN 2026-11-14 (issue #246, probe re-run at the 0.8.0 pin; NO field
changed by this paragraph): the 2026-10-27 paragraph above noted that
re-running layout/probe-readiness at 0.8.0 would be a separate, later
record. That record now exists, at
layout/probe-readiness/runs/klt-0.8.0/ (19 files, the same set as the
0.7.1 run), taken from a throwaway `uv` venv holding
klayout-tools==0.8.0 -- the host tool (klt 0.9.2.dev1022+g2a9c52b27ce7)
was neither used nor modified. All eleven commands were repeated and
every exit code is identical to the 0.7.1 run (drc/extract/ring-check
x2/economy 0; five LVS 3; lvs-simform-recognized-cap-rsil3 0), as is
every verdict-bearing LVS field and the extracted netlist's sha256.
probe.gds regenerates byte-identical under this install
(sha256:9759f9ee...db0b), so no layout change was committed. Outcome on
the question the re-run was for: npn13G2 still extracts as NO device at
the pinned release (device_count 2 -- cap_cmim + rsil), and
lvs-simform-full is still `mismatch`, exit 3; gap G1 is now DECLINED
upstream by ruling rather than open (klayout-tools#1232 / #2864 /
#3137-closed-by-PR-#3431-warning-text-only / #2849 not_planned), so no
new upstream issue was filed for it. One new gap was found and filed
generically: klt ring-check's JSON record carries no provenance block
(2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5650). Environment deltas worth noting next to
the pin: the bundled klayout moved 0.30.12 -> 0.30.13, which is NEWER
than the klayout==0.30.12 klt 0.8.0 declares it was tested against, so
drc/lvs records at this pin carry provenance.klayout_version_mismatch
true and each run prints the engine-version disclosure warning
(verdicts unaffected per that warning; klayout_package_min's 0.30 floor
re-checked and unchanged). Record schema_versions moved at this
release: drc 2->3, extract 3->4, lvs 1->2; economy and ring-check stay
1. The DRC deck also grew -- 24 rules checked (was 21), with new
psd.area.1/psd.space.1/psd.width.1 now covering the probe's pSD layer
-- and the run is still clean. Per-command detail and the superseding
status table: layout/probe-readiness/README.md.
ERC + SHARED PIN CHECK 2026-11-14 (issue #198, LNA stage-1 device-group
layout study): klt_required_commands grows from the five probe commands
to six -- `erc` is added, because layout/lna_stage1/run_checks.sh invokes
it for the T1 item 11 supply half. `klt erc` exists at the current pin
(klayout-tools==0.8.0) and needs no pin bump: no field other than
klt_required_commands changed in this paragraph, and no record under
layout/probe-readiness/runs/ was re-run or rewritten by it.
CORRECTION 2026-11-14 (issue #198, to the 2026-10-12 paragraph above):
that paragraph says "layout/probe-readiness/generate_probe.py is, for
now, the one runner that checks this list before doing anything". It does
not -- that file contains no reference to this document, so the claim
described an intent that no code ever implemented. Per the append-only
rule above, this correction is a new paragraph rather than an edit to the
one it corrects, and generate_probe.py is left unchanged (it is a
non-claiming probe, and rewriting it is out of scope for #198). The ONE
shared implementation this comment block asks for now exists, at
layout/toolchain_pin.py: require_commands() for this list,
require_pdk_cells() for the PDK primitives a generator instances, and
resolve_pr_gds()/pdk_install() for the pinned PDK itself. It is imported
by layout/lna_stage1/generate.py and realizability.py, invoked by
layout/lna_stage1/run_checks.sh before any check runs, and runnable on
its own as `python3 layout/toolchain_pin.py --check --klt <path>`. Every
future layout/ runner should use it rather than re-deriving the check.
